name: zvideo_d3d_scene_enter
description: zVideoD3D::SceneEnter opens a Direct3D scene only when the scene-depth counter is closed.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo Direct3D scene/render-state pass because final code shape depends on the scene-depth wrapper pair and provider calls.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a74d0 validates the g_zVideo_D3DSceneDepth guard, the call to zVideo_dd3d::BeginSceneAndFlushPendingRenderStates only when depth is nonpositive, incrementing the depth, and returning 0.
The native fake-Direct3D smoke verifies SceneEnter opens the scene from depth 0, sets depth to 1, and does not reopen when already entered.
